about.description: A local-first notebook for ideas, diagrams and margin notes. Built with Fluent Design, liquid-glass surfaces and a fast Canvas 2D ink engine.
about.shortcutsTouch: Two-finger hold to move · pinch to zoom
about.fineprint: Made for quiet thinking. Open source under GPL-3.0. Build

pwa.title: Install Paligraph
pwa.description: Install Paligraph as an app for a focused window, home-screen icon and offline access.
pwa.installedBody: You are using the installed app experience.
pwa.available: Your browser can install Paligraph as an app.
pwa.iosAvailable: Add Paligraph to your Home Screen from Safari.
pwa.manualAvailable: Install from your browser menu or address bar.
pwa.promptBody: Install for quick access and offline-ready files.
pwa.iosPromptBody: Add it to your Home Screen from Safari’s share menu.
pwa.manualPromptBody: See how to install it in your browser.
pwa.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
pwa.iosStep3: Confirm the name and tap Add.
pwa.desktopStep1: Open the browser menu (or the install icon in the address bar).
pwa.installUnavailable: Installation is not available in this browser. Use Settings → Install for instructions.
backup.hint: Browsers can clear local data. Export an editable .paligraph backup regularly.
